newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down amid selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down amid selling pressure.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower on profit taking by small investors, brokers said.
Brokers said a selling pressure brought down the prices of majority shares ending a market rally. "A market correction was due following a sharp rise of most blue chips," said one broker.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index fell 32.09 points or 2.03 percent at 1,545.97 on a turnover of 177 million taka. Of the 123 issues traded, 85 closed down, 32 ended up and six unchanged.
IDLC shed 293.85 taka to 4,100, Bangladesh Lamps lost 363.40 to 4,122.92 and Chittagong Cement Klinker was down 48.34 to 3,898.70. -- Dhaka Newsroom 88-02-506363
